response.text:
I need a bit more detail before I can send anything — "yes" doesn't tell me which option you want, and I can't send AUD 6,500 from an account holding AUD 1,000.

Could you confirm one of these?

1. **Top up first** — you'll move money into your AUD account, then I pay the full AUD 6,500.
2. **Partial payment** — tell me the amount (up to AUD 1,000) to send now.
3. **Something else** — e.g. pay from a different source.

Also note: any payment of AUD 6,500 is a large amount, so I'll ask you to confirm the exact figure in chat right before sending.
